Name: Minimum ambient light
Description: Apply a minimum ambient lighting value to the map

Name: Ambient occlusion
Description: Enable Ambient Occlusion baking

Name: Ambient occlusion (alias)
Description: Same as -ambientocclusion

Name: Preview ambient occlusion
Description: Visualize ambient occlusion only (disables all lights)

Name: AO brush samples
Description: Adjust number of AO face samples for brushes (128 on -final, 16 on -fast)

Name: AO prop samples
Description: Adjust number of AO face samples for props (32 on -final, 12 on -fast)

Name: AO radius
Description: Ambient Occlusion radius

Name: AO intensity
Description: Ambient Occlusion intensity multiplier

Name: Append content search paths
Description: Add an extra search path behind the ones from gameinfo.txt Multiple paths can be specified with a , (comma)

Name: Game base directory
Description: Path to the game's base directory, deduced from the mod directory by default

Name: both (Tools++)
Description: Compile in LDR and HDR mode

Name: bounce (Tools++)
Description: Set max number of bounces. Zero disables bouncing

Name: Box3D physics
Description: Load vphysics_box3d to trace collision data

Name: centersamples (Tools++)
Description: Move sample centers

Name: chop (Tools++)
Description: Smallest number of luxel widths for a bounce patch Used on edges

Name: choptexlights (Tools++)
Description: Enables chopping of texture lights generated from a lights file

Name: coring (Tools++)
Description: Light threshold to force to blackness (minimizes lightmaps)

Name: CPU-only lighting
Description: Calculate lighting only on the CPU

Name: debugextra (Tools++)
Description: Places debugging data in lightmaps to visualize supersampling

Name: dispchop (Tools++)
Description: Tightest number of luxel widths for a displacement patch Used on edges

Name: DisplacementLightingOld (Tools++)
Description: Same as -dispsamplefactor 2.2 and -disppatchsamplefactor 2.2

Name: disppatchradius (Tools++)
Description: Maximum radius allowed for displacement patches Used in face interiors

Name: disppatchsamplefactor (Tools++)
Description: Radius of bounced lighting influence for displacements

Name: dispsamplefactor (Tools++)
Description: Radius of lighting influence multiplier for displacements

Name: dlight (Tools++)
Description: Minimum light threshold for creating texlights

Name: dlightmap (Tools++)
Description: Move sample centers

Name: dump (Tools++)
Description: Write patches to debug files

Name: dumpnormals (Tools++)
Description: Write normals to debug files

Name: dumppropmaps (Tools++)
Description: Dump prop lightmaps to game's 'sp_lightmaps' folder

Name: dumptrace (Tools++)
Description: Write ray-tracing environment to debug files

Name: extendedsoftlimits (Tools++)
Description: Disables warning about exceeding soft limits

Name: extrasky (Tools++)
Description: Trace N times as many rays for indirect light and sky ambient

Name: extrasoft (Tools++)
Description: Trace N times as many rays for soft lights

Name: fast (Tools++)
Description: Quick and dirty lighting

Name: fastambient (Tools++)
Description: Per-leaf ambient sampling is lower quality to save compute time

Name: fastradial (Tools++)
Description: Use fast radial accumulation

Name: final (Tools++)
Description: High quality processing. Equivalent to: -extrasky 8 -extrasoft 4 -StaticPropSampleScale 4 -aofacesamples 96 -aopropsamples 32

Name: forcetextureshadows (Tools++)
Description: Force all props to allow casting texture shadows

Name: Game directory (managed by app)
Description: Path to the mod directory holding gameinfo.txt

Name: globalreflectivityscale (Tools++)
Description: Scale the $reflectivity of all textures In comparison to -reflectivityScale, this scales bounced contribution on brushes, props and ambient cubes

Name: GPU submission time
Description: How long one GPU submission may run, in seconds Lower it if the display driver is timing out

Name: hdr (Tools++)
Description: Compile in HDR only mode

Name: indirectonly (Tools++)
Description: Bake only indirect lighting into the map

Name: Prepend content search paths
Description: Add an extra search path in front of the ones from gameinfo.txt Multiple paths can be specified with a , (comma)

Name: LargeDispSampleRadius (Tools++)
Description: Same as -disppatchsamplefactor 2.2

Name: ldr (Tools++)
Description: Compile in LDR only mode

Name: Lightmap format
Description: Layout of the lighting lump rgbe - colors only rgbea - plus alpha rgbea3 - plus alpha per bump rgbeastyle3 - plus alpha per bump per style)

Name: lights (Tools++)
Description: Load a lights file in addition to lights.rad and the level lights file

Name: loghash (Tools++)
Description: Log the sample hash table to samplehash.txt

Name: low (Tools++)
Description: Run as an idle-priority process

Name: luxeldensity (Tools++)
Description: Rescale all luxels by the specified amount

Name: maxbrushes (Tools++)
Description: Set maximum brush limit

Name: maxbrushsides (Tools++)
Description: Set maximum brushside limit

Name: maxchop (Tools++)
Description: Coarsest allowed number of luxel widths for a patch Used in face interiors

Name: maxdispinfo (Tools++)
Description: Set maximum displacement limit

Name: maxdispsamplesize (Tools++)
Description: Set max displacement sample size

Name: maxtexinfo (Tools++)
Description: Set maximum texinfo limit

Name: minlightcullintensity (Tools++)
Description: Minimum light threshold where non-styled lights should be cutoff

Name: minstyledlightcullintensity (Tools++)
Description: Minimum light threshold where styled (i.e. named) lights should be cutoff Lowering this can increase lightmap filesize and lower in-game performance

Name: Content mount configuration
Description: Path to a mount.cfg listing extra content to mount Intended for Garry's Mod

Name: nodetaillight (Tools++)
Description: Don't light detail props

Name: noextra (Tools++)
Description: Disable supersampling

Name: noextradisp (Tools++)
Description: Disable supersampling on displacements

Name: nolightcull (Tools++)
Description: Don't cull lights by distance

Name: nopairedges (Tools++)
Description: Don't pair brush edges for radial accumulation

Name: nopairgeometricedges (Tools++)
Description: Don't pair brush edges geometrically to prevent lighting seams when in contact with neighboring brush entities

Name: noskyboxrecurse (Tools++)
Description: Turn off recursion into 3d skybox (skybox shadows on world)

Name: nossprops (Tools++)
Description: Globally disable self-shadowing on static props

Name: nostyledlights (Tools++)
Description: Named lights become static lights, or are removed if initially dark

Name: notexscale (Tools++)
Description: Disable scaling texlights based on texture scale

Name: notextureshadows (Tools++)
Description: Undo every texture shadow option

Name: onlydetail (Tools++)
Description: Only light detail props and per-leaf lighting

Name: OnlyStaticProps (Tools++)
Description: Only perform direct static prop lighting

Name: patchlightmapsize (Tools++)
Description: Minimum lightmap scale for patch chopping

Name: propalpha (Tools++)
Description: Bake the direct sun amount into the prop vertex lighting's alpha

Name: propambient (Tools++)
Description: Trace props for ambient lighting

Name: propdebug (Tools++)
Description: List props being processed for debugging

Name: rederrors (Tools++)
Description: Show radial light errors as black instead of red

Name: reflectivityscale (Tools++)
Description: Scale the $reflectivity of all textures This only affects bounced lighting between brushes

Name: report_search_paths (Tools++)
Description: Show search paths for assets

Name: scale (Tools++)
Description: Intensity multiplier of all lights

Name: skipAmbientLights (Tools++)
Description: Skip ambient lights

Name: skipLocalLights (Tools++)
Description: Skip point and spotlights for baking

Name: skipPVS (Tools++)
Description: Skip PVS optimization for lights

Name: skipSunLights (Tools++)
Description: Skip sun lights

Name: smooth (Tools++)
Description: Set the threshold for smoothing groups, in degrees

Name: softsun (Tools++)
Description: Treat the sun as an area light source of size <n> degrees Produces soft shadows

Name: StaticPropIndirectMode (Tools++)
Description: Override prop indirect lighting algorithm (0 - default, 1 - TF2, 2 - Orangebox)

Name: StaticPropLighting (Tools++)
Description: Generate backed static prop vertex lighting

Name: StaticPropNormals (Tools++)
Description: When lighting static props, just show their normal vector

Name: StaticPropPolys (Tools++)
Description: Perform shadow tests of static props at polygon precision

Name: StaticPropSampleScale (Tools++)
Description: Scales the number of samples used by direct/indirect lighting on props -final uses a scale of 4

Name: StopOnExit (Tools++)
Description: Wait for a keypress on exit

Name: supportslightdirectional (Tools++)
Description: Disables classname renaming of light_directional

Name: supportslightprojected (Tools++)
Description: Disables classname renaming of light_projected

Name: textureshadows (Tools++)
Description: Allow texture alpha channels on props to block light Rays intersecting alpha surfaces will sample the texture

Name: Worker threads
Description: Number of threads to use. Defaults to max CPU thread count

Name: translucentshadows (Tools++)
Description: Enables texture shadows on $translucent surfaces

Name: v (Tools++)
Description: Turn on verbose output

Name: verbose (Tools++)
Description: Turn on verbose output

Name: worldtextureshadows (Tools++)
Description: Same as -textureshadows but for world geometry
